name: Immersive Vanilla Bannerlord
description: From the Steam Workshop collection 3493018660 (checked on Steam 2026-10-29: all 14 items public; collection updated 2026-03-31). Close to the base game, more atmosphere: Total War Music, Realistic Weather, historical and AI banner icons, Helmet Hair Cover, Beards Fix, Dismemberment Plus, Diplomacy. The official modules are added when you create the playset, and Auto-sort puts Harmony, ButterLib, UIExtenderEx and Mod Configuration Menu first. Most of these mods were made for 1.3/1.4: check each mod's page for your game version. Not tested in a game.
